title: Top Floor Condo w/Pool – Steps to Broadway, SoBro
description:
Located in the "SOBRO" neighborhood, the heart of downtown Nashville, you will be within walking distance to award-winning restaurants, honky-tonks, sports and music venues plus lush parks & trails. This top floor, beautifully decorated, centrally located space guarantees a stylish & easy to navigate experience.

The space
Guests can easily walk to several Nashville attractions like:

- Music City Center Convention Center - 5 minute walk

- Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum - 7 minute walk

- Bridgestone Arena, the Nashville Predators games and concerts - 8 minute walk

- Broadway and Honky Tonks - 8 minute walk

- Printer’s Alley and Skull’s Rainbow Room - 15 minute walk

- Nissan Stadium and the Tennessee Titans games and concerts - 20 minute walk

- First Horizon Park, the Nashville Sounds games and Germantown area - 30 minute walk

Other modes of transportation are easily accessible like Lyft, Uber, and several electric scooter rental options.

Whether you’re planning a girl's trip, a family vacation, or work retreat, this modern SoBro escape puts you right in the heart of the action, while still providing a peaceful and calm place to come back to after a fun day bar hopping, line dancing, watching a Titans game, or just having brunch with friends.

LIVING ROOM:
Top floor corner with amazing balcony downtown and pool view with sofa bed, smart TV, fully equipped kitchen, and ample seating for guests.

BEDROOM 1:
One King-sized bed with a large walk-in closet and sectioned off personal bathroom.

BEDROOM2:
One Queen-sized bed with a large walk-in closet and bathroom right outside the door. Includes a Queen-Sized air mattress for a fourth bedding option located in the closet, and also a Pack n Play for guests with infants (please bring your own sheet for the pack n play)

KITCHEN:
Granite countertops, and a full kitchen that is fully stocked with dishware, cooking utensils, coffee machine, dish washer, round dining table, and high-top chairs. 

PARKING: We offer one parking space in the garage under the building for $35/night. The building has additional parking spaces if needed.

Guest access
As a guest, you'll have full access to Unit 1033, along with shared community amenities including a resort-style pool, outdoor kitchens with grilling stations, a fully equipped fitness center, and modern conference rooms—all available at no extra cost.

Other things to note
There is a key locker system for key retrieval that is simple to use. Instructions will be sent prior to check-in.
